name: boards
about: Create a board and put a note on it. A network with no board shows the new-board form; a used one opens straight onto its last board, so the walk opens the board list from the switcher. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 canvas/src/presentation.rs:1403 — the canvas is a MouseArea with no role: placing, drawing, selecting and its menu are pointer-only
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 canvas/src/presentation.rs:3581 — the note editor has no label
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 canvas/src/presentation.rs:2551 — markdown note text is RichText: not in the tree
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 canvas — a card has no node but its text label: an empty card and the selection are pixels only

steps.say: open the Boards tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Boards tab is selected and the boards view shows either the new-board form (a Name a new board field and a Create board button: the network has no board yet) or the last board open (a board switcher button named for that board, a sync label such as Saved, a Board canvas button and the tool buttons); no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: bring up the new-board form: press the board switcher (the button at the top left named for the open board) to open the board list; if no board is open and the Name a new board field already shows, press the Boards tab in the rail instead, which keeps the form
steps.expect: a Name a new board field and a Create board button show

steps.say: type the board name into the Name a new board field
steps.expect: the Name a new board field holds QA board {param:walk_tag} and Create board is enabled
the new board opens: the board switcher button is named QA board {param:walk_tag}, and the Board menu dialog may remain open over the board

steps.say: if the Board menu dialog is open, press the expanded board switcher named QA board {param:walk_tag} to dismiss it; otherwise leave the board as it is
steps.expect: the Board menu dialog is closed, the board switcher is named QA board {param:walk_tag}, and an Add a note button shows
a note editor opens and a Done button shows

steps.say: type the note text into the new note

steps.expect: the board shows a label reading qa note {param:walk_tag} and the sync label reads Saving 1 change… or Saved (not Not saved)
